subject: Operational Marshall Plan & Milepost Roster - Kickoff and Owner Slate
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@aurora-cloud.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.dev>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Operational Marshall Plan & Milepost Roster - Kickoff

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our infra team reviewed Redwood’s latency profiles and we want to move forward with a staged pilot. Before we lock dates, we need a concise mutual action plan (MAP) that calls out milestones, owners, blackout windows, and acceptance criteria.

Top-level asks from Aurora: 
- a 6-week pilot timeline with explicit milestone dates
- on-call and rollback owners for each milestone
- a single procurement/contract milestone (DocuSign) we can gate on

I attached our initial requirements workbook (Attachment: initial_requirements.xlsx). Can your team propose an owner roster and a compact milestone schedule by EOD Tuesday? Elaine

--
Elaine Park
Head of Cloud Operations | Aurora Cloud
elaine@aurora-cloud.com
Attachment: initial_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet, 89 KB)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.dev>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@aurora-cloud.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.dev>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.dev>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Operational Marshall Plan & Milepost Roster - Kickoff

Elaine — thanks for the clear asks. Looping in Monica (Implementation) and Ben (Solutions) to scope owners and the runbook.

Attached is a compact MAP draft (Attachment: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx) and a one-page runbook outline (Attachment: runbook-outline.md). High-level proposed mileposts (week numbers relative to kickoff):
1) Week 0: Contract sign (DocuSign) + billing setup — Owner: Mateo Alvarez (CS)
2) Week 1: Dev validation + test harness (smoke tests) — Owner: Ben Carter (Solutions)
3) Weeks 2–3: Integration & KV-cache tuning (staged) — Owner: Monica Patel (Implementation)
4) Week 4: Load run + latency SLA verification — Owner: Monica + Ben
5) Week 5: Cutover window (production pilot) + 72-hour monitoring — Owner: Aurora ops with on-call from Redwood (Ben)

Blackout/No-deploy windows: Aurora requested local weekend blackout (Sat 00:00–Sun 23:59 PST) during Week 4. We propose the production cutover on Tue of Week 5 to avoid the blackout.

Next steps I propose: 
- Your confirmation of the blackout preference and contract milestone date (we can provision a DocuSign envelope by EOD tomorrow)
- Monica to fill detailed task owners and acceptance criteria in MAP-draft-v1.xlsx
- Weekly 30-min sync (Wednesdays) — first sync Wed Dec 2 at 10:30 PT?

If that schedule looks reasonable I’ll convert the MAP to a tracked HubSpot milestone calendar.

Regards,

Mateo Alvarez
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.dev
Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 72 KB); runbook-outline.md (text, 6 KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.dev>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.dev>, Elaine Park <elaine@aurora-cloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.dev>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Operational Marshall Plan & Milepost Roster - Kickoff

Thanks — I reviewed the MAP draft and pushed a couple of changes worth calling out: 
- Integration window: shift KV-cache tuning to Weeks 2–4 (longer runway) because Aurora’s test harness indicated variable seq lengths that can affect kernel selection.
- Add an Engineering review gate between Week 3 and Week 4 to sign off on batching/quantization profile for the pilot. Owner: Ben (Solutions) + Aurora Eng.

Acceptance criteria (short):
- Smoke tests pass on staging for 72 hours (no token errors > 0.1%)
- Average p95 latency under 280ms for pilot traffic profile
- Audit logs & KMS integration validated (security questionnaire items 3–7)

I updated MAP-draft-v1.xlsx: see the Tasks tab for owners and the Acceptance tab for criteria. I can take the first run of the runbook and hand it over to Ben to expand the troubleshooting matrix.

Monica
Implementation Manager | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.dev

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.dev>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.dev>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.dev>, Elaine Park <elaine@aurora-cloud.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Operational Marshall Plan & Milepost Roster - Kickoff

Agree with Monica on adding the Eng review gate. One operational item to add: procurement must be complete before we schedule the Week 1 test harness provisioning — procurement milestone should be a hard gate.

Action items for procurement gate:
- Mateo: confirm DocuSign envelope created and recipient list (we need Aurora legal + PM)
- Elaine: confirm purchase order number (PO) or external billing contact for provisioning

DocuSign link (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/some-doc/abcdef123456

I’ll expand the runbook troubleshooting matrix after Monica drops the first draft into the shared Drive. Suggest we lock the DocuSign for Thu Dec 3 to keep the cadence.

—Ben
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.dev

Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.dev>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.dev>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Operational Marshall Plan & Milepost Roster - Kickoff

Thanks team — this looks good and aligns with our internal windows. A few small items: 
- We can commit to the DocuSign milestone on Thu Dec 3. Please include our Legal (legal@aurora-cloud.com) on the envelope.
- For the engineering review gate, Aurora will assign an on-call engineer (name to follow) but we need the runbook troubleshooting matrix before Week 3.

I’m happy to confirm the blackout windows as proposed and lock the Tue Week 5 cutover. Wed Dec 2 10:30 PT is OK for the weekly sync; I’ll join remotely (Zoom link is our default).
